name: print-social-new-vision-maker-gloved-hand-fanning-gaming-posters
title: 'New Vision Maker' cover: a gloved hand fans out gaming ad cards against a blue night sky
whatItIs: A deep blue dusk scene with a lone figure on a plain, a script-and-caps 'New VISION Maker' title, and a black gloved hand holding a fan of five portrait ad designs (gaming mouse, controller 'Take Full Control', headset) like playing cards.
whatItMeans: Confident and cinematic; the card fan presents a portfolio as a winning hand.
techniques: Fan work samples like playing cards in a hand.
Mix a script word with bold caps in the title.
Set everything in a moody, lone-figure landscape.

vocabulary.definition: Items spread in an arc like held cards.
An atmospheric backdrop that sets emotion.
